note: Settings backup/restore validation vectors (docs/protocol; firmware sys/backup and harbor/src/features/backup/validate.ts). Input is the file bytes (hex; text is for the reader). 'keys' lists what a successful validation applies, in document order: setting keys, then nvs:<ns>.<key>. Errors: too_large (over max_bytes, checked first), not_json, bad_schema, unknown_key, bad_value; not_json (syntax of the whole document) comes before every other check; then the first schema/key/value problem in document order wins, and a missing schema or kind is bad_schema once the whole document was read. Files live in /data/backup: settings-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.json (written by the device), restore.json and patch.json (uploaded by Harbor, applied at the next start). Strings must be printable ASCII (the device rejects \u escapes).
